# XiaoNiuBuNiu

> Independent Software Maker (XiaoNiuBuNiu). Ships local-first apps for macOS and
> Android, built solo and documented in public. 10-year full-stack engineer
> (Java/Android, SwiftUI, TypeScript/Next.js, Python).

## Products

- [ActionSense](https://www.xiaoniubuniu.com/products/action-sense): Free, open-source (MIT) macOS menu-bar app. Detects what you copy (URLs, colors, math, JSON, addresses...) and puts the right action at your cursor. No shortcut, no window. Download: https://www.xiaoniubuniu.com/downloads/ActionSense_2.0.dmg
- [BrowserDrop](https://www.xiaoniubuniu.com/products/browserdrop): Android app, live on Google Play. Shares a chosen phone folder over local Wi-Fi as a web workspace — browse/preview/download/upload from any browser. No cloud, no account, no PC client. Install: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.xiaoniubuniu.browserdrop
- [WebMedia Scanner](https://www.xiaoniubuniu.com/products/webmedia-scanner): Android app, live on Google Play. Sniffs hidden videos, audio, images and files out of any web page with three detection engines; m3u8/HLS downloader that decrypts AES-128 and remuxes to one playable MP4; resume, batch save, hotlink handling. No cloud, no account; DRM streams intentionally unsupported. Install: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.xiaoniubuniu.mediadownloader
